entropy.existing_secure_path: C getrandom(flags=0) -> Rust rand::getrandom(flags=0) -> secure readiness syscall 89 -> capability lookup rand -> bounded GET IPC in 32-byte chunks. Malformed/missing/timeout failures wipe the buffer and map generic EIO. No clock/PID fallback.
entropy.required_by: Python/bootstrap_hash.c:105 calls getrandom with GRND_NONBLOCK for nonblocking startup entropy.
entropy.missing: Nonblocking secure-service transport/readiness with truthful EAGAIN/error semantics. Existing bounded IPC can wait and does not implement GRND_NONBLOCK.
entropy.private_bit_warning: Rust GRND_NONCRYPTO bit 1 selects local noncryptographic PRNG. It is never exported/aliased as C GRND_NONBLOCK.
entropy.native_existing_coverage: Legacy random readiness/service witnesses, guards, zero-length and invalid flags; results in regression matrix. No cryptographic quality or nonblocking qualification inferred from those functional tests.

signals.native_subset: Initial-thread synchronous SIGUSR1/SIGUSR2 registration, raise and deferred same-signal delivery only. syscall 174 rejects workers/groups and nonzero mask/SA flags. kill and sigprocmask return ENOSYS.
signals.native_existing_coverage: Legacy synchronous signal controls only; unsupported asynchronous behavior remains BLOCKED.

process_identity.reason: Native getpid syscall returns current worker pid; only linux_tgid receives a group override. No misleading C process-identity export added.
